note: McLean County ND publishes a zoning ordinance (PDF) and a county GIS hub with a zoning map document that has no queryable zoning service; its GIS parcel viewer (mygisonline Portico / ArcGIS experience) carries parcels with no zoning layer. The only 'Zoning - McLean County' ArcGIS item (mcgisweb.org OpenData MapServer/18) is McLean County, Illinois, not ND. Washburn zoning is only on a vendor map (zoninghub) with no service endpoint; Garrison, Turtle Lake and Underwood publish no zoning service found.
